stages.label: Recorded market history
stages.narrative: A citywide neighborhood heatmap shows governed annual sale aggregates on one shared 5th-to-95th-percentile color scale without inventing missing prices.

stages.label: Buildings rise
stages.narrative: Recorded filing, permit, construction-year, and occupancy milestones drive visible building stages; interpolated stages remain modeled.

stages.label: 2026 capacity snapshot
stages.narrative: Current mapped FAR identifies scenario candidates while explicitly withholding parcel feasibility claims.

stages.label: Development scenarios
stages.narrative: A 31-member conditional price-only surface spreads across governed neighborhoods while selected-region development remains a separate detailed model.

stages.label: Intervals and comparison
stages.narrative: The selected policy settles beside an executable synchronized business-as-usual branch with shared exogenous draws, sector-correct supply, visible spatial evidence, invariants, and explicit forecast-validation refusal where pipeline history is unavailable.

seeds.label: Greenpoint history and growth
seeds.description: Replay Greenpoint's recorded market and building milestones, then continue under business-as-usual assumptions.
seeds.missionText: Replay and forecast Greenpoint residential development and sale prices.

seeds.label: Long Island City capacity expansion
seeds.description: Test a zoning-capacity expansion against the same governed Long Island City history and seed.
seeds.missionText: Replay Long Island City and simulate a zoning-capacity expansion scenario.

seeds.label: Mott Haven affordability
seeds.description: Explore higher affordable-unit participation and additional capacity in Mott Haven-Port Morris.
seeds.missionText: Replay Mott Haven-Port Morris and simulate an affordability-first development policy.

seeds.label: SoHo financing squeeze
seeds.description: Apply high financing and construction costs to commercial development capacity in SoHo, Little Italy, and Hudson Square.
seeds.missionText: Replay SoHo commercial property history and simulate a financing squeeze.
